findings.evidence: packages/core/src/foundation-effects.ts:281-284 only propagates cancellation of an already unknown run to Hermes; packages/core/src/coding-execution.ts:124-129 and :159-164 determine publication from task cancellation, cleanup revocation, epoch, deadline and scope, without any generic Foundation cancellation marker.
findings.refutation: CodingEngine.cancel itself first marks cancel_requested and is safe. However, the existing owner Foundation cancellation API also accepts this run ID. On an unknown coding run that path revokes already-revoked grants without marking coding cancellation; reconciliation can then accept stopped-success output and settle succeeded.
findings.suggestion: Propagate unknown-run cancellation for exact local.coding/coding.run into durable coding cancellation, then test unknown -> generic Foundation cancel -> stopped-success reconciliation retains cancelled state and suppresses result.

findings.evidence: packages/core/src/foundation-data.ts:242-250 and packages/core/src/foundation-effects.ts:179-181, :216-219, :233-236 exempt only Hermes from held/expired environment restrictions for read-only reconciliation. CodingEngine.reconcile delegates through those checks.
findings.refutation: Refusing dispatch into held or expired environments is required, and uncertain coding capacity stays retained safely. Read-only inspect is explicitly different: these gates block it before physical truth can be observed, so stopped coding resources cannot be reconciled after HOLD/expiry and the singleton pool remains occupied.
findings.suggestion: Add exact local.coding/coding.run read-only recovery exemptions at all reconciliation gates, preserve late-output revocation checks, and test expired/HOLD stopped proof releases uncertainty without publishing results.

findings.evidence: apps/console/src/components/agents-coding.tsx:254-261 only renders retained patch bytes inside details/pre; coding-runners-design.md:67 AC-793 explicitly requires downloading an inert patch. Coding routes/endpoints have no download operation.
findings.refutation: The owner can inspect and manually copy inline bytes, and an additional server route is not mandatory because bytes are already owner-authorized. Manual copying still does not implement the requested download behavior.
findings.suggestion: Provide a bounded inert text patch download using the retained bytes and a server-controlled filename, without applying it or navigating to a runner URL; verify exact downloaded bytes.

findings.evidence: packages/contracts/src/http-endpoints.ts:44 still declares CONTROL_API_VERSION 1.12.0 while coding-endpoints.ts adds the coding API surface; coding-runners-core-implementation.md explicitly flags the pending additive-version decision.
findings.suggestion: Apply the coordinator's additive API policy (1.13.0), regenerate OpenAPI and verify checked-in contract output.
